This is the Thunderbird for desktop operating systems forum. You might be better off asking your question in the Thunderbird for Android forum where its experts reside.

https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/questions/thunderbird-android

But I will say this... Spectrum (including, presumably, TWC) has been having severe connectivity problems that affect all email agents, for several weeks at least, though they rarely admit it. We are watching the situation closely, but there's not much we can do.

According to Spectrum's help web page <https://www.spectrum.net/support/internet/mobile-email-setup>, that is a valid address, but it is not online right now, which is why you're getting the "Unable to resolve host" error. Hopefully that's a temporary situation, but you would have to check with them for status.
